Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City 'M&'w.dilg.gov.ph DILG OPINION No. 110 s. 2021 AUG 3 1 2021 VICE MAYOR FRANCISCO GUERRERO, Jr. Municipality of Padada Province of Davao del Sur Dear Vice-Mayor Guerrero: This refers to your letter dated 15 July 2021 requesting the Department's legal opinion concerning the legality of naming an Anti-Crime Group after an incumbent Local Chief Executive. As represented in your letter, an anti-crime group was created in your municipality which was named after the incumbent Local Chief Executive (LCE), naming the certain group as — CAMINERO ANTI-CRIME GROUP. Under such premise, arose your query conceming the legality of naming the said group after the incumbent LCE. At the onset, please be apprised that the Department is an agency under the Executive Branch of the government. As such, it has no authority to declare the legality or illegality of any acts committed by the local government officials. Notwithstanding, for mere purposes of academic discussion, we respectfully submit our view on the matter. This Department submits that using the name of local officials any local government documents, projects, and programs finds no basis in the law. In fact, pursuant to the General Provisions of the 2021 General Appropriations Act (GAA), government officials — whether elected or appointed are prohibited from putting their names on programs, projects and any other initiatives that are funded by the government through the GAA. Specifically, Section 82 of the 2021 GAA states, viz: "Sec. 82. Prohibition on the Attachment of the Name, Image, and Likeness of Public Officials on Government Projects. Subject to guidelines to be issued by the DBM, it shall be prohibited to affix, or cause to be affixed, the name, visage, appearance, logo, signature, or other analogous image of any public official, whether elected or appointed, on all programs, activities, projects (PAPs) or corresponding signage are funded in this Act." Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

In addition, public service is imbued with the highest degree of commitment to public interest over personal interests. Consistent with this longstanding ideal, the Department strictly upholds good local governance as one of its main thrusts. Thus, it is but necessary and proper under the existing circumstances and public policy to at all times strictly observed the highest ideals in government service and refrain from associating or naming Programs, Projects, Activities and any other initiatives funded from the peoples' coffers. This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have guided you accordingly. Thank you.
